# beszel_system (Resource)

Manages a monitored system on a Beszel hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beszel_system" "example" {
  name  = "web-1"
  host  = "10.0.0.1"
  users = [beszel_user.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address the agent connects from.
- `name` (String) Display name of the system.
- `users` (List of String) IDs of Beszel users who own this system.

### Optional

- `port` (String) Agent port. Left unset, Beszel assigns/reports one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) PocketBase record ID of the system.
- `info` (String) Agent-reported system info, as a raw JSON string.
- `status` (String) Agent-reported status: up, down, paused, or pending.
